state.description: Two-letter state code, copied from targets.csv

name.description: County name exactly as in targets.csv

online_application.description: Whether residential solar permit applications can be submitted online, with the sentence that says so

value.description: true when applications can be submitted online (portal or e-permit system); false only if the page says they cannot; null if the page does not say

quote.description: The sentence from the page that supports value, copied verbatim; null when value is null

solarapp_plus.description: true when the county accepts SolarAPP+ automated plan review for residential solar; null if SolarAPP+ is not mentioned

required_documents.description: Documents an applicant must submit with a residential solar permit application, each named in a few words (e.g. 'site plan', 'one-line diagram'); empty when none are listed
